name: HelpScout
description: Receives HelpScout webhooks and provides tools for conversation management

webhookSecret.description: HelpScout webhook HMAC-SHA1 secret for signature verification

helpscoutUserId.description: Nick's HelpScout user ID for loop prevention (filters out self-triggered agent reply events)

gatewayPort.description: Gateway HTTP port for localhost POST to /hooks/agent

agentId.description: OpenClaw agent ID to target for webhook-triggered sessions

webhookSecret.label: Webhook Secret
webhookSecret.help: The secret key configured in HelpScout's webhook settings (Manage > Apps > Webhooks)

helpscoutUserId.label: HelpScout User ID
helpscoutUserId.help: The HelpScout user ID of the agent account this plugin authenticates as

gatewayPort.label: Gateway Port
gatewayPort.help: The local HTTP port the OpenClaw gateway listens on

agentId.label: Agent ID
agentId.help: Which OpenClaw agent should handle webhook events
